description:
Nosso projeto será uma história com uma personagem chamada Maggie que é uma robô exploradora e ela ira encontrar vestigios de rochas em marte e ela também encontrarar amigos e muito mais! 

Our project will be a story featuring a character named Maggie, an explorer robot who discovers rock samples on Mars; she will also make friends and much more!
summary: Our project aims to reactivate NASA’s exploratory robots to promote the care and cleaning of both planet Earth and outer space. This initiative is essential, given the growing accumulation of space debris in Earth’s orbit and environmental pollution on our own planet. By assigning a new mission and practical purpose to this technological equipment, we combine sustainability with space exploration to ensure a cleaner and safer future both on Earth and beyond.
details:
Project Details: Maggie and Space

This project presents the story and mission of Maggie, a NASA exploration robot living on Mars. The narrative illustrates how she cares for, preserves, and continuously improves the Red Planet, drawing an educational and inspiring parallel that encourages us to do the same for Earth and outer space.

• Environmental awareness: Promotes attitudes of care, preservation, and sustainability on Earth.

• Science education: Sparks interest in space exploration, robotics, and astronomy in an accessible and engaging way.

• Space responsibility: Encourages reflection on the human impact beyond Earth—such as addressing space debris and preserving other celestial bodies.

The primary goal is to inspire a shift in behavior. We want people to view Earth as a precious home that requires daily maintenance, using the positive example of Maggie’s dedication on Mars to engage students and the broader community in environmental protection and science.

To bring this concept to life, the team combined design tools with artificial intelligence:

• Canva: Used to create the overall visual identity, layout, illustrations, and the final project presentation.

• ChatGPT and Claude AI: Employed to develop the script, structure Maggie’s narrative, edit the text, and refine creative ideas.

The key creative differentiator is the use of storytelling through a space-themed analogy. Rather than approaching ecology in a traditional way, we created a charismatic character on another planet to mirror the attitudes we need to adopt here blending science fiction, technology, and ecological consciousness.

Accessible language: The project translates complex topics such as space exploration and sustainability into a message that is both easy to understand and engaging.

• Visual appeal: The use of compelling graphic elements to capture and hold the audience's attention throughout the presentation.

• Emotional connection: Fostering empathy through the character Maggie, showing that taking care of the place where we live is everyone’s mission.
